versions.changelog: Add script-based fallback fetcher and improved Cloudflare/challenge handling guidance

Initial release of web-fetcher skill:

- Fetches web pages and converts them to Markdown for easier reading and processing.
- Automatically tries multiple conversion services (r.jina.ai, markdown.new, defuddle.md) for the best chance of success.
- Designed for tasks involving reading, extracting, or crawling content from specific URLs.
- Example usage instructions and fallback strategy included in skill documentation.
